🔖 Ethereum price charges toward $2,000 as Nasdaq rally revives demand 

🔔 Ethereum price has climbed from $1,800 to an intraday high near $1,945 after a technology-led Wall Street rebound revived risk appetite, although resistance below $2,000 has kept traders cautious.

⚠️ According to data from cryptonews, Ethereum price traded near $1,929 at the time of writing, about 6% above its July 21 low. Buyers initially followed U.S. equities higher as the Nasdaq Composite gained 1.3% and the S&P 500 added 0.9%, led by semiconductor and artificial intelligence stocks. Micron rose 12.2%, while Nvidia advanced 2%. Notably, enthusiasm around upcoming technology earnings drove the session.

👀 Momentum also improved against Bitcoin. Crypto trader Daan Crypto Trades noted that ETH has outperformed BTC during the third quarter after falling 29.26% in the first quarter and another 25.28% in the second. CoinGlass data shared by the trader showed Ethereum up 22.98% so far in Q3, compared with an average third-quarter return of 8.86% since 2016. According to Daan, the rebound followed Ethereum’s weakest first half since 2022, making the recovery less unusual despite Q3’s historically slow performance. 

🔗 Bitcoin’s ability to retain its recent gains therefore remains relevant to ETH’s next move. A fresh Bitcoin sell-off could drain demand from altcoins even if Ethereum continues to outperform on a relative basis.

🎙 Pezeshkian advocates for comprehensive Iran-Iraq cooperation pact

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian has called for the development of a comprehensive strategic cooperation program to guide long-term relations between Tehran and Baghdad.

During a meeting with Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Falih Kadhim al-Zaidi and his accompanying delegation in Tehran on Thursday, President Pezeshkian prioritized drafting a cooperation program to enhance long-term ties across all sectors. He also emphasized that the security of both nations is intertwined.
​
The president called for the rapid implementation of economic and infrastructure agreements and urged full compliance with existing security pacts, especially in border areas.
​
Pezeshkian envisioned an integrated rail and road network to boost transit, investment, and trade, drawing parallels to European models of regional cooperation.
​
He also highlighted deep-rooted cultural bonds, citing the Arbaeen pilgrimage and Iraqi tributes to Iran’s martyred Leader as symbols of a brotherhood.
​
The Iraqi prime minister, for his part, reaffirmed Baghdad’s strategic commitment to Tehran, vowing that Iraqi territory would never serve as a base for threats against the Islamic Republic.
​
Expressing gratitude for Iran’s support in defeating terrorist groups, al-Zaidi stressed that Baghdad remains fully dedicated to bilateral security cooperation.
​
He noted that his high-level delegation, which includes key economic ministers, is in Tehran to finalize agreements across trade, healthcare, and academia, aiming to turn mutual intentions into tangible outcomes for both nations.

​Elon Musk's statements are interesting not because he is a visionary, but because he is part of a team building a new digital future.

Elon Musk warns that time is running out:

According to him, there are only three years left during which it will still be possible to make a living, mainly by selling your working time. As AI progresses, most tasks can be automated, making this economic model less relevant.

The idea of "I exchange my time for a salary," dominant for almost 200 years, is on the verge of disappearing. This could lead to one of the most significant wealth redistributions in modern history.

According to this vision, the next three years should be used to transform your time into assets that are difficult to replace with AI: Bitcoin and other rare digital assets, land, energy, infrastructure, networks, and production capacities.

As a result, the message is: in the future, the most valuable thing will not be the time you sell, but the assets you own.

Those who anticipate this shift will be able to gain a significant advantage by 2035-2036.

I think very few people believe in this right now, and no one is prepared for it.
